questions.question:
A: What day is today?
B: It's ______. It's the first day of school this week!
questions.commonMisconception: 將第一天上學日與週日混淆。
questions.explanation: 每週上課的第一天通常是星期一 (Monday)。

questions.question: Today is ______. Tomorrow is Sunday. We don't have school!
questions.commonMisconception: 星期的先後順序判定錯誤。
questions.explanation: 如果明天是週日且不用上學，那今天就是週六 (Saturday)。

questions.question: My favorite day is ______. It is the day before Thursday.
questions.commonMisconception: 星期的前後對應力弱。
questions.explanation: 週四的前一天是週三 (Wednesday)。

questions.question:
______ day is today?
It's Tuesday.
questions.commonMisconception: 誤用 When (問日期或具體時間點)。
questions.explanation: 詢問「今天是星期幾」的固定句型為 'What day is today?'。

questions.question:
A: Is today Friday?
B: ______, it's Friday.
questions.commonMisconception: 誤以為可以用縮寫 Yes, it's 作為句子結尾。
questions.explanation: 對於 'Is today...?' 的肯定簡答，最正式且正確的結構是 'Yes, it is'。

questions.question:
A: Is it Monday today?
B: No, ______. It's Sunday.
questions.commonMisconception: 助動詞選取錯誤。
questions.explanation: 否定語境下，對於 'Is it...?' 的答覆應為 'No, it isn't'。

questions.question: Today is Wednesday. ______ is Thursday.
questions.commonMisconception: Today / Tomorrow / Yesterday 詞義混淆。
questions.explanation: 今天週三，明天 (Tomorrow) 是週四。

questions.question: Which sentence is CORRECT?
questions.commonMisconception: 星期的首字母未大寫。
questions.explanation: 英文中的星期名稱第一個字母必須「大寫」。
options: We have art class on Monday.

questions.question: We have English class ______ Friday.
questions.commonMisconception: 誤用 in 或 at。
questions.explanation: 在「星期幾」，介係詞應使用 'on'。

questions.question:
We have PE class on Tuesday. We have music class on Friday. 
Question: What day do we have music class?
questions.commonMisconception: 資訊比對錯誤。
questions.explanation: 文中敘述 'We have music class on Friday'。

questions.question:
Today is Tuesday. My birthday party is in two days (兩天後).
Question: What day is the party?
questions.commonMisconception: 日期計算錯誤。
questions.explanation: 週二的兩天後 (週三、週四) 是週四 (Thursday)。

questions.question:
Dad says, 'We can't go to the park on Monday to Friday. We can only go on the weekend.' 
Question: When will they go to the park?
questions.commonMisconception: 不了解 weekend 的具體範圍。
questions.explanation: 週末 (weekend) 指的是週六和週日。選項中只有週六符合。

questions.question:
Today is Friday. I will go home tomorrow. I will stay home for two days (Saturday and Sunday). Then I go to school.
Question: What day does school start?
questions.commonMisconception: 邏輯鏈條過長導致推算錯誤。
questions.explanation: 週五後天回家，在家待週六、週日，接著週一 (Monday) 上學。

questions.question:
I play soccer every Monday and Wednesday. Toby plays soccer every Tuesday and Thursday.
Question: Do they play soccer on the same day?
questions.commonMisconception: 資訊提取不全。
questions.explanation: 兩人打球的日期完全沒有重疊。

questions.question: We go to the park on ______. We go there every week.
questions.commonMisconception: 不知星期名稱可加 s 表達頻率概念。
questions.explanation: 表達「每個星期幾」，可以使用 'on Sundays' (複數名詞) 或 'every Sunday'。

questions.question: The month (月份) starts on Monday. What day is the third (第3) day?
questions.commonMisconception: 基數與序數對應落差。
questions.explanation: 1號是週一，2號是週二，3號是週三 (Wednesday)。

questions.question: It will rain on Saturday. It will be sun on Sunday. We should go camping on ______.
questions.commonMisconception: 因果判定錯誤。
questions.explanation: 露營應選晴天，所以是週日 (Sunday)。

questions.question: In many cultures, ______ is the first day of the week, but in schools, Monday is the first day.
questions.commonMisconception: 不了解中西曆法文化差異。
questions.explanation: 在西方宗教文化或許多曆法中，週日 (Sunday) 被視為一週的第一天。

questions.question:
A: Where is the ball?
B: It's ______ the box. Look, it's inside!
questions.commonMisconception: 介係詞基本義義混淆。
questions.explanation: 描述為 'inside' (在裡面)，對應的方位介係詞是 'in'。

questions.question: The book is ______ the table. It's next to the lamp.
questions.commonMisconception: 將 on (上方) 與 under (下方) 弄反。
questions.explanation: 書放在桌子上方，使用介係詞 'on'。並註明在燈旁邊。

questions.question: Toby is ______ the desk. We can only see his feet (腳)!
questions.commonMisconception: 空間視覺推理落差。
questions.explanation: 只能看到腳，推論其餘身體部位在桌子下方，故選 'under'。

questions.question:
A: Where ______ my keys?
B: They are under the sofa.
questions.commonMisconception: 主謂單複數不一致。
questions.explanation: 主詞為複數 'keys'，對應的 B 動詞是 'are'。

questions.question:
______ is Mom?
She's in the kitchen.
questions.commonMisconception: 疑問詞與回答內容不對應。
questions.explanation: 回答為地點 'in the kitchen' (在廚房)，問句應使用 'Where' (在哪裡)。

questions.question:
A: Are the pens on the desk?
B: No, they ______. They are in my bag.
questions.commonMisconception: 助動詞與 B 動詞混淆。
questions.explanation: 對於 'Are they...?' 的否定回答為 'No, they aren't'。

questions.question:
A: Is your bag ______ the chair?
B: Yes, it is. It's hanging (掛著) there.
questions.commonMisconception: 對掛放動作的介係詞聯想不足。
questions.explanation: 掛在椅子上面，方位使用 'on'。

questions.question: ______ my pencil? I can't find it.
questions.commonMisconception: 單複數判定錯誤。
questions.explanation: 單數 pencil 搭配 'Where is'。選項中 A 為完整形式。

questions.question: The cat is ______ the door. It wants to go out.
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識 by 的方位用法。
questions.explanation: 在門「旁邊」，使用介係詞 'by' (或 next to)。

questions.question:
The doll is on the bed. The ball is under the bed. The bag is by the window. 
Question: Where is the ball?
questions.commonMisconception: 資訊比對錯誤。
questions.explanation: 文中明確說 'The ball is under the bed'。

questions.question:
We have an apple in the basket. We have a banana on the table. 
Question: Is there a banana in the basket?
questions.commonMisconception: 方位與物品配對錯誤。
questions.explanation: 香蕉是在桌子上 (on the table)，而非籃子裡。

questions.question:
A: Is the key on the table?
B: No, it is under the newspaper. The newspaper is on the table.
Question: Can you see the key easily (輕易地)?
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合兩層空間關係進行常識推理。
questions.explanation: 鑰匙在報紙下面，所以無法輕易看見（被蓋住了）。

questions.question:
The cat is not under the sofa. It is not in the box. Ah, it is on your shoulder (肩膀)!
Question: Where is the cat?
questions.commonMisconception: 否定排除法應用力不週。
questions.explanation: 排除前兩個地點後，最後指點貓在肩膀上。

questions.question:
I am standing (站) by the tree. My dog is behind the tree. 
Question: Can I see my dog?
questions.commonMisconception: 視覺盲區的空間判斷力不足。
questions.explanation: 狗在樹後，我在樹旁，中間隔著樹，所以看不到狗。
options: No, the tree is in front of the dog.
Yes, the dog is in front.

questions.question: The pen is ______ the pencil and the eraser.
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識 between 或用法掌握不精。
questions.explanation: 描述在「兩者之間」，使用介係詞 'between'。

questions.question: Your apple is ______ your lunch box. Open it and eat!
questions.commonMisconception: 缺乏動詞暗示的情境推理。
questions.explanation: 根據指令 'Open it' (打開它)，推論蘋果在盒子「裡面」(in)。

questions.question: Come and sit ______ me. There is a chair here.
questions.commonMisconception: 介係詞選用不自然。
questions.explanation: 邀人坐下，「在某人旁邊」座席，使用 'by' (或 next to / beside)。

questions.question: In a restaurant, put your napkin (餐巾) ______ your lap (大腿).
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備文化行為相關介係詞應用。
questions.explanation: 餐巾應覆蓋在大腿「上方」，使用 'on'。

questions.question:
A: What time is it?
B: It's six ______. Time for dinner!
questions.commonMisconception: 拼寫錯誤或誤用 clock (鐘)。
questions.explanation: 描述整點時間，使用固定詞彙 'o'clock'。

questions.question:
A: It's ______ o'clock. Wake up, Lily!
B: Oh, it's early. It's seven in the morning.
questions.commonMisconception: 數字單字認讀錯誤。
questions.explanation: 根據後句 'seven in the morning'，得知現在是七點。

questions.question: It's ______ o'clock. Go to sleep! It is very late.
questions.commonMisconception: 時間觀念判定。
questions.explanation: 描述為很晚了 (very late)，選項中十二點最適當。

questions.question:
______ time is it?
It's ten o'clock.
questions.commonMisconception: 誤用 When (When 常用於問日期或非精確點)。
questions.explanation: 詢問時間的固定句型為 'What time is it?'。

questions.question: It's twelve o'clock. Time ______ lunch.
questions.commonMisconception: 介係詞誤用。
questions.explanation: 表達「是做的某事的時間了」，句型為 'Time for [名詞]'。

questions.question:
A: Is it three o'clock?
B: No, ______. It's four o'clock.
questions.commonMisconception: 格式不規範。
questions.explanation: 對於 'Is it...?' 的否定回答為 'No, it isn't'。

questions.question: It's four o'clock. It's time to ______ home.
questions.commonMisconception: 動詞形式錯誤。
questions.explanation: 句型 'It's time to [原形動詞]'。

questions.question:
A: What time is it?
B: It's ______ o'clock. (8:00)
questions.commonMisconception: 易混字母順序拼錯。
questions.explanation: 8 的正確拼法是 eight。

questions.question: The lesson starts ______ nine o'clock.
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 in (月份) 與 at (整點)。
questions.explanation: 在「特定的整點時間」，介係詞應使用 'at'。

questions.question:
Lily eats lunch at twelve. She goes to the park at four. 
Question: What time does Lily go to the park?
questions.commonMisconception: 數據提取錯誤。
questions.explanation: 文中敘述 'She goes to the park at four'。

questions.question:
It's two o'clock now. The movie starts in one hour (一小時後). 
Question: What time does the movie start?
questions.commonMisconception: 簡單時間加減錯誤。
questions.explanation: 兩點的一小時後是三點 (Three)。

questions.question:
School starts at eight o'clock. Toby arrives (抵達) at nine o'clock. 
Question: Is Toby late?
questions.commonMisconception: 因果判定及 B 動詞簡答格式。
questions.explanation: 學校八點開始，他九點才到，所以遲到了。回答用 'Yes, he is'。

questions.question:
The cartoon is on from five to seven o'clock. 
Question: How many hours is the cartoon?
questions.commonMisconception: 時間跨度計算能力不足。
questions.explanation: 五點到七點，中間共兩小時。

questions.question:
Dad: 'It's nine o'clock. Time for bed.' 
Son: 'Can I have ten more minutes (再十分鐘)?' 
Question: What time will the son go to bed?
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合數值與詞語進行模糊推理。
questions.explanation: 九點再加十分鐘，即為九點過後 (After nine)。

questions.question: It is ______ now.
questions.commonMisconception: 詞序顛倒。
questions.explanation: 正確的時間表達結構為 '[數字] o'clock'。

questions.question:
A: Can you come to my house at six?
B: Sorry, I am busy ______ six. How about seven?
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略對話細節中的重複文法規律。
questions.explanation: 介係詞固定用法，整點時間配 'at'。

questions.question:
My clock is slow. It says (顯示) ten, but it is actually (實際上) eleven. 
Question: What time is it now?
questions.commonMisconception: 邏輯逆推錯誤（誤以為要減一小時）。
questions.explanation: 時鐘慢了，顯示十點實際上應是十一點。

questions.question: In New York, it's night. In Taipei, it's day. They have different ______.
questions.commonMisconception: 詞彙運用。不可以用 'different o'clock'。
questions.explanation: 地處不同城市，時間不同。'different time' 為正確搭配。

questions.question:
A: Can you ______?
B: Yes, I can. I love music.
questions.commonMisconception: 將動詞與名詞/形容詞混淆。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 'can' 後接原形動詞。根據 'love music' (喜愛音樂)，選項中只有 'dance' (跳舞) 為合理的動作動詞。

questions.question: He can ______ very fast. He is like a tiger!
questions.commonMisconception: 詞彙語意辨識錯誤。
questions.explanation: 形容動作很快且像老虎一樣，最適當的動詞是 'run' (跑)。

questions.question: My sister can ______ a beautiful bird.
questions.commonMisconception: 情境詞彙搭配不當。
questions.explanation: 針對 'beautiful bird' (美麗的小鳥)，最合理的才藝動詞是 'draw' (畫)。

questions.question:
______ you swim?
Yes, I can.
questions.commonMisconception: 誤用 Do 或 Are 開頭。
questions.explanation: 詢問能力（是否會某事），使用助動詞 'Can' 開頭，且回答也使用了 'can'。

questions.question: She ______ sing very well. Listen!
questions.commonMisconception: 分不清 can 與 B 動詞用法。
questions.explanation: 表示能力「會唱歌」，使用 'can'。且 can 後接原形動詞 'sing'。

questions.question:
A: Can your brother fly?
B: No, he ______. He is not a bird!
questions.commonMisconception: 簡答助動詞選取錯誤。
questions.explanation: 對於 'Can...?' 的否定回答為 'No, he can't' (cannot)。

questions.question: I can dance. ______ you?
questions.commonMisconception: 習慣用語掌握不熟。
questions.explanation: 詢問「那妳呢？」最常用的句型是 'How about you?'。

questions.question: Toby can ______ high. Look at him!
questions.commonMisconception: 受第三人稱主詞影響誤加 s 或 ing。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 'can' 後面固定接「原形動詞」。

questions.question: Ducks can swim, but they ______ fly high.
questions.commonMisconception: 邏輯對應錯誤。
questions.explanation: 對比連結詞 'but' 表示前後意向相反。鴨子會游泳，「但不會」飛得很高。

questions.question:
Sam can run fast. May can sing. Ken can draw. 
Question: Who can make a beautiful song?
questions.commonMisconception: 詞彙轉換（sing 與 song）的關聯理解。
questions.explanation: 文中敘述 May 會唱歌 (can sing)，所以她能創作出好聽的歌曲。

questions.question:
Frogs can jump. Fish can swim. Birds can fly. 
Question: Which animal can move (移動) in the sky?
questions.commonMisconception: 方位常識與英文動作連結落差。
questions.explanation: 鳥類會飛 (fly)，是在天空中移動的動物。

questions.question:
A: Can you play the piano?
B: No, but I can play the guitar.
Question: What can B do?
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略轉折詞 but 以後內容。
questions.explanation: B 說不會彈鋼琴，但「會彈吉他」。

questions.question:
Mom: 'Can you help me cook?' 
Son: 'I can wash the rice, but I can't cook.' 
Question: Will the son help Mom?
questions.commonMisconception: 局部肯定與整體肯定的邏輯判斷。
questions.explanation: 兒子表示會幫忙洗米，即為一種幫忙的形式。

questions.question:
My robot can do many things. It can walk and talk. It cannot eat food.
Question: Can the robot eat a pizza?
questions.commonMisconception: 無法進行類屬推理。
questions.explanation: 文中明確說 'It cannot eat food'，披薩是食物，故不能吃。

questions.question:
A: ______ can swim well?
B: The blue fish can.
questions.commonMisconception: 疑問詞選取受限於人類/非人類刻板印象。
questions.explanation: 回答是 'The blue fish' (藍色的魚)，雖然魚是動物，但在擬人或詢問「誰」具備此能力時可用 'Who' 或 'Which one'。在此選項中 'Who' 是最接近詢問主體的選項（相較於 What/Where/How）。

questions.question: The water is deep. You ______ swim here. It is dangerous.
questions.commonMisconception: 因果邏輯推理不當。
questions.explanation: 水很深且危險，所以「不能/不可以」在這裡游泳。

questions.question: Lily is a good singer. She ______ join the music club.
questions.commonMisconception: 語意連接力。
questions.explanation: 她是有才華的歌手，所以「能夠/可以」加入音樂社團。

questions.question: Spiders have eight legs. They can ______ very well.
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備詞彙 climb 的情境想像。
questions.explanation: 蜘蛛有八條腿，最擅長的能力是爬行 (climb)。

questions.question: A: Can you swim? B: No, I ______.
questions.explanation: Can you...? 的否定回答是 No, I can't。

questions.question: 'She can play the piano.' means '她會彈鋼琴'。
questions.explanation: can play the piano 表示會彈鋼琴。

questions.question: A: Can he ______? (跑步) B: Yes, he can run very fast.
questions.explanation: can 後面接動詞原形 run。

questions.question: Fish ______ swim in the water.
questions.explanation: 表示能力用 can。

questions.question: A: What can you do? B: I can ______ a bike.
questions.explanation: can 後面接動詞原形。
